{"edits": [{"finding_ids": ["app/profiles.py:8:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:9:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:10:optional-no-default"], "search": "    bio: Optional[str]
    website: Optional[str]
    age: Optional[int]", "replace": "    bio: Optional[str] = None
    website: Optional[str] = None
    age: Optional[int] = None", "explanation": "In Pydantic v2, a field annotated `Optional[T]` with no default is required (migration.md#required-optional-and-nullable-fields). Adding `= None` restores the v1 behavior where these fields defaulted to None and could be omitted."}], "notes": "Finding app/profiles.py:15:test-failure (profile_from_form) needs no separate change. The test fails only because `bio` is missing from the form dict, and the v2 "Field required" error comes from the Optional-without-default issue. Adding `= None` to bio, website, and age (one edit covering lines 8–10) makes the missing keys default to None, so the test should pass. profile_from_form itself is valid v2 code and is left unchanged. Unrelated lines (username, interests: List[str] = []) are untouched. No v1-only APIs (validator, Config, .dict(), parse_obj) are present, so no other edits are needed. Verification: run tests.test_profiles::test_blank_fields_become_none after applying the edit."}
